It incorrectly assumed that the final shape in the trajectory must have taken the longest time to reach, conflating spatial position with temporal duration. It ignored the explicit timing data (e.g., 4.00s from white to purple) and instead relied on a spatial heuristic (farthest = longest time). This constitutes a major temporal reasoning error and a misinterpretation of the question’s intent.
